in_marathi.name: Dhanapal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanapal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhanapal is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'dhan' meaning wealth and 'pal' meaning protector or ruler. This name signifies one who is a protector or ruler of wealth and prosperity.
